concept: The Growing Place — a fresh, welcoming garden-center palette. A leafy botanical green leads, grounded by deep forest ink and warm cream backgrounds, with a sun-ripened terracotta secondary and a bright marigold-bloom accent that pops vividly on dark hero imagery. Soft cream tints keep section backgrounds light and airy so lush plant photography stays the star.
contrastNotes: All required ratios verified (sRGB WCAG formula). ink #152A1C on bg = 13.85:1 (>=7); ink-soft #3F5847 on bg = 7.08:1 (>=4.5); white on primary #3C7A41 = 5.18:1 (>=4.5); primary-dark #2B5A30 on bg = 7.33:1 (>=4.5); accent #F08A3C on #000 = 8.41:1 (>=3). surface-alt #EDE7D6 is a LIGHT cream tint (slightly deeper than bg) — ink on surface-alt = 12.32:1 and ink-soft on surface-alt = 6.30:1, so dark text stays AA+ on section backgrounds. Bonus: ink on surface(#fff)=15.22:1, white on primary-dark=8.05:1, secondary #B94E27 on bg=4.57:1 and white-on-secondary=5.02:1 (usable for text/buttons).
